info.name: Password Health — score card & cards
info.description:
CredVault › Password Health: the score card (total, passed, failed / need attention, and how many of those are weak, reused, missing 2FA, rotation due and over-shared), the five cards with their "N of M" line, and the list of credentials that need attention.

APIs
• GET /credvault/health/summary — score card + five cards
• GET /credvault/health/attention — the failing credentials, one row each
• GET /credvault/health — the issue list (its `summary` is the same as /health/summary)

BEFORE YOU START
Fill baseUrl, email/password, adminEmail/adminPassword and managerEmail/managerPassword. Run 00 · Setup, then the folders in order (folder 03 compares with the counts saved in folder 01).

Full details: docs/CREDVAULT_VAULTS_API_SHEET.md → Password Health.

item.name: 01 · Score card — total, passed, failed, need attention
item.description:
GET /health/summary — the score card and the five cards, without the list.

Score card:
• total — credentials checked (owned, administered and the team's; not ones only shared with you)
• passed — credentials with no open issue ("35 of 53 credentials are healthy")
• failed — credentials with at least one issue ("18 need attention")
• score = passed ÷ total × 100; level Good (80+) · Fair (60–79) · At risk (under 60)
• pct.passed / pct.failed

attention — the "need attention" count split by issue:
• by_type { weak, reused, twofa, rotation, shared } — how many of the failed credentials have each issue
• single / multiple — failing one check / more than one. A credential can fail several checks, so by_type adds up to more than failed; single + multiple = failed.
• issues — open issues in all (a credential with two issues counts twice)

Same `summary` is also on GET /health (the list).

exec: pm.test('attention: by_type = the cards; single + multiple = failed', () => { b.data.cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(b.data.attention.by_type[c.key]).to.eql(c.failed)); pm.expect(b.data.attention.single + b.data.attention.multiple).to.eql(b.data.failed); pm.expect(b.data.attention.total).to.eql(b.data.failed); });

pm.test('attention: by_type = the cards; single + multiple = failed', () => { b.data.cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(b.data.attention.by_type[c.key]).to.eql(c.failed)); pm.expect(b.data.attention.single + b.data.attention.multiple).to.eql(b.data.failed); pm.expect(b.data.attention.total).to.eql(b.data.failed); });

pm.test('attention: by_type = the cards; single + multiple = failed', () => { b.data.cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(b.data.attention.by_type[c.key]).to.eql(c.failed)); pm.expect(b.data.attention.single + b.data.attention.multiple).to.eql(b.data.failed); pm.expect(b.data.attention.total).to.eql(b.data.failed); });

item.name: 02 · The five cards — Weak · Reused · Missing 2FA · Rotation due · Over-shared
item.description:
cards[] in the screen's order. Each card:
• failed — credentials failing that check (the big number)
• of — credentials the check applies to:
    weak, reused — credentials with a password
    twofa — credentials whose risk level the policy needs 2FA for (Policies → "Two-factor authentication required for"), 2FA not "N/A"
    rotation — credentials with a password and a rotation period
    shared — every credential checked
• passed = of − failed · pct = failed ÷ of · sub = "4 of 34 passwords below policy"
• issues — the issue rows of that type on GET /health (= its tab count) · critical — of those, critical
• pct_of_attention — failed ÷ the credentials that need attention

exec: pm.test('5 cards: weak, reused, twofa, rotation, shared', () => pm.expect(b.data.cards.map(c => c.key)).to.eql(['weak', 'reused', 'twofa', 'rotation', 'shared']));

pm.test('each card: passed + failed = of, pct, "N of M" line', () => b.data.cards.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c.passed + c.failed).to.eql(c.of); pm.expect(c.pct).to.eql(c.of ? Math.round(c.failed / c.of * 100) : 0); pm.expect(c.sub.startsWith(c.failed + ' of ' + c.of + ' ')).to.eql(true); }));

pm.test('weak and reused out of the credentials with a password', () => { const c = k => b.data.cards.find(x => x.key === k); pm.expect(c('weak').of).to.eql(b.data.with_passwords); pm.expect(c('reused').of).to.eql(b.data.with_passwords); });
pm.test('over-shared out of every credential', () => pm.expect(b.data.cards.find(x => x.key === 'shared').of).to.eql(b.data.total));
pm.test('5 cards: weak, reused, twofa, rotation, shared', () => pm.expect(b.data.cards.map(c => c.key)).to.eql(['weak', 'reused', 'twofa', 'rotation', 'shared']));

pm.test('each card: passed + failed = of, pct, "N of M" line', () => b.data.cards.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c.passed + c.failed).to.eql(c.of); pm.expect(c.pct).to.eql(c.of ? Math.round(c.failed / c.of * 100) : 0); pm.expect(c.sub.startsWith(c.failed + ' of ' + c.of + ' ')).to.eql(true); }));

item.name: The list agrees — GET /health tabs = card issues

exec: pm.test('tab counts = each card issues', () => b.summary.cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(b.tabs[c.key]).to.eql(c.issues)));

item.name: 03 · Need attention — the failing credentials, one row each
item.description:
GET /health/attention?tab=all|weak|reused|twofa|rotation|shared&q=&page=&per_page=
One row per credential that needs attention (GET /health lists one row per issue). Each row: credential (id, code, name, type, owner, scope, url…), can_fix, issue_count, types[], severity (its worst issue), issues[] (type, severity, issue, detail, details, action).
Sorted worst first, then most issues. tabs: all (= summary failed) and one count per issue type (= attention.by_type). Search: credential ID, name, type, owner, issue.
Run folder 01 first: these requests compare with the counts it saved.

exec: try { const v = b.data.length ? b.data[0].credential.code : ""; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('hcCredCode', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

pm.test('one row per credential, with all its issues', () => b.data.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.credential).to.include.keys('id', 'code', 'name', 'owner'); pm.expect(r.issue_count).to.eql(r.issues.length); pm.expect(r.types.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r).to.include.keys('severity', 'can_fix'); }));
pm.test('worst first', () => { const r = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2 }; for (let i = 1; i < b.data.length; i++) pm.expect(r[b.data[i - 1].severity]).to.be.at.most(r[b.data[i].severity]); });
pm.test('every row has the weak issue', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.types).to.include('weak')));
pm.test('every row has the reused issue', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.types).to.include('reused')));
pm.test('every row has the twofa issue', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.types).to.include('twofa')));
pm.test('every row has the rotation issue', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.types).to.include('rotation')));
pm.test('every row has the shared issue', () => b.data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.types).to.include('shared')));
pm.test('found when the employee has an issue', () => pm.expect(b.meta.total).to.be.at.least(pm.collectionVariables.get('hcCredCode') ? 1 : 0));

pm.test('one row per credential, with all its issues', () => b.data.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.credential).to.include.keys('id', 'code', 'name', 'owner'); pm.expect(r.issue_count).to.eql(r.issues.length); pm.expect(r.types.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r).to.include.keys('severity', 'can_fix'); }));

item.name: 04 · Search — the tab counts follow it
item.description:
GET /health?q= and GET /health/attention?q= — the tab badges (`tabs`) are counted for the search typed, exactly what each tab lists for it; clearing the search brings back the whole vault's counts. The score card and the five cards (`summary`) stay the whole vault.
Run folder 03 first: these search the credential ID it saved.

exec: pm.test('the all badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['all']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the weak badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['weak']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the reused badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['reused']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the twofa badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['twofa']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the rotation badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['rotation']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the shared badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['shared']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
pm.test('the cards stay the whole vault', () => pm.expect(b.summary.failed).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('hcFailed'))));

item.name: Search cleared: badges = the whole vault

exec: pm.test('each badge = its card issues', () => b.summary.cards.forEach(c => pm.expect(b.tabs[c.key]).to.eql(c.issues)));
pm.test('the all badge = the rows this tab lists for the search', () => pm.expect(b.tabs['all']).to.eql(b.meta.total));
